name: Petjo
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible
sweep_summary: Petjo (petj1238) is not in the catalog. Its two stress/accent-keyword bibliography items — Weber, Braun & Crocker 2006 (Language and Speech) and de Ruiter 2009 (The Linguistic Review) — are both German pitch accent/intonation studies that Glottolog attached to Petjo by a computerized keyword assignment from the word 'referents' (the Glottolog records say so explicitly); neither is about Petjo or about word stress, so both are irrelevant (priority none). Abstracts were obtained via Crossref/Glottolog; full texts are paywalled. A first-hand Petjo stress statement remains unread: the best available lead is Cress 1998 (Petjoh: woorden en wetenswaardigheden uit het Indische verleden), pp. 26-27, which Wikipedia paraphrases as word stress and intonation being 'very similar to Malay'; Cress 1998 and van Rheeden 1994/1995 are print-only and should be acquired (high priority) if Petjo is to be coded.

earlier_scan.source_named: Only Amade 1997 (word order) and van Rheeden 1994 (short sketch/wordlist); no phonological description of Petjo located.
